green/700.use: the wordmark green, light chrome (the app's accent in light)

green/400.use: the brand hue lifted for dark chrome: the meter, the ring, the wave on ink

green/200.use: the design system's UI-and-code green highlight (unused on the phone yet)

green/100.use: the design system's UI-and-code green fill (unused on the phone yet)

green/mist.use: the pale green the orb lightens into

cobolt.use: AssemblyAI's primary violet: the drop, never a key or a surface

violet/lavender.use: the orb's lightest violet: its top and the gradient's ends

violet/periwinkle.use: the orb's mid violet: the drop's halo

violet/iris.use: the orb gradient's upper violet stop

ink.use: the brand ink: the Mac pill's body, the ink theme's surface

ink/800.use: a modifier key on ink; the Mac's dark card fill

ink/700.use: an ordinary key on ink, one step up

warm-white.use: key legends on ink: warm white on warm ink

card.use: the warm card fill; the paper theme's surface

card-border.use: the card's hairline; the paper theme's modifier key

orange.use: the error word and ring, cancel, the Full Access note; never a red body

paper/page.use: the design system's page: the app's light ground

paper/tint.use: the warm off-white one step in: light cards, dark legends

paper/300.use: neutral-200: a modifier key on the light face

paper/400.use: neutral-300: hairlines and field borders on the light face

neutral/900.use: black-400: body text on the light face

neutral/700.use: black-300: muted text and mono labels on the light face

neutral/500.use: black-200: mono labels on the dark face

app/accent-light.use: the catalog's AccentColor in light: Blurt green, the one accent every screen and the CTA take

app/page-light.use: the catalog's Page in light: the design system's page

app/page-dark.use: the catalog's Page in dark: ink, the website's ground

app/muted-light.use: the catalog's Muted in light: eyebrows, captions, secondary text

app/cta-light.use: the catalog's CTA in light: the one accent button

app/cta-dark.use: the catalog's CTA in dark: the one accent button

app/cta-text-dark.use: the catalog's CTAText in dark: ink on green, as the site

app/keep-open-tint-1-light.use: the drifting wordmark on the Blurt-is-on card, a colour per wall in turn: the accent first

app/keep-open-tint-3-light.use: then the green a step lighter

app/keep-open-tint-4-light.use: then the muted grey, and round again

key/height.use: every cap: the iPhone's, measured (apple-geometry-glass-402.json); with row/gap it is KeyboardKit's row height

key/gap.use: between caps, the iPhone's: half each side is KeyboardKit's cell inset

row/gap.use: between rows, the iPhone's: half above and half below is KeyboardKit's cell inset

margin/side.use: at the keyboard's sides: the iPhone's cap margin, (402 − 10 letters − 9 gaps) / 2; less half a key gap is KeyboardKit's edge inset

margin/vertical.use: between the bar and the first row of caps: with voicebar/height it is the iPhone's 52.667 pt band above the keys

key/radius.use: every cap's corner: the iPhone's (fitted 8.17), set on KeyboardKit's button style

key/min-width.use: the probe field's height in the app: the iPhone's 123 key at 402 pt

voicebar/height.use: the bar above the keys (KeyboardKit's toolbar), in the slot Apple's suggestion bar takes: the status line, the + and the key-term field

caret/lead.use: the caret's gap from the text

glyph/hit.use: the +, × and ✓ touch targets: the HIG's 44 pt square around a size/glyph symbol

addterm/inset.use: the bar's side padding: the status line from the leading edge, the + from the trailing one

addterm/chip-gap.use: between the chip's glyph and the word

addterm/chip-max-width.use: the widest the chip grows in the bar, so the status line keeps its room; a longer word truncates

opacity/disabled.use: the + without Full Access; a brand button that can't be pressed yet

opacity/press-brighten.use: a key lightens this much while pressed

margin/bottom-keys.use: under the bottom row of caps: the iPhone's; less half a row gap is KeyboardKit's bottom edge inset

key/reference-width.use: the width the @402 tokens were measured at (iPhone 18 Pro); widths scale from it

key/abc-width-402.use: 123, the globe and the mic at 402 pt: the iPhone's small bottom-row key, pinned so every other cap keeps Apple's width

opacity/off.use: the mic key's glyph when Blurt isn't ready — dim and still, but there: a tap opens the app

opacity/glint.use: the cross glint when the words land

radius/button.use: the brand's buttons and the grille: rectangular, never a pill

radius/input.use: the brand's inputs: the key-term field

opacity/grain-dark.use: film grain over the dark face: matte, the brand's texture

term/radius.use: the key-term field: the brand's input corners (radius/input)

app/header-height.use: the home header: wordmark and gear

app/stack-gap.use: between a section's eyebrow and its content, and between cards

app/icon.use: the header's gear, the copy glyph

opacity/pressed.use: a brand button while pressed: a colour change, no lift

app/tab-height.use: a tab in the brand tab bar: its icon over its mono label

app/tab-gap.use: between a tab's icon and its label

app/input-pad-y.use: an app input's top and bottom (its sides are app/chip-pad-x)

app/pill-pad-y.use: a key-term pill's top and bottom, and its side beside the ×

app/pill-remove.use: the × on a key-term pill: its tap square

app/row-remove.use: the × on a text-shortcut row: its tap square

app/row-pad-y.use: a list row's top and bottom inside a card

app/stat-gap.use: between the stats in the card, and between its rows

typing/line-spacing.use: between the lines of words to type

typing/words-height.use: the least room the words take, so the field below stays put

typing/field-border.use: the typing field's border, orange once a word goes wrong

typing/pulse.use: the countdown's thump in the last five seconds

app/try-box-height.use: the least height of the home screen's "Try it here" box: two lines

keep-open/wordmark-height.use: the wordmark drifting on the Blurt-is-on card: twice the header's

keep-open/speed.use: how far it drifts along each axis in a second, so the path is the 45° zigzag

keep-open/corner-tolerance.use: touching one edge this close to the other counts as an exact corner

keep-open/flare-arm.use: the corner flare's vertical arm, as a fraction of the wordmark's height

keep-open/flare-span.use: and its horizontal arm, as a fraction of the wordmark's width

stat/unit-ratio.use: a stat's mono unit (hr, min, sec) as a fraction of its number's size

stat/part-gap-ratio.use: between a stat's number-and-unit parts, as a fraction of its size

stat/unit-gap-ratio.use: between a number and its unit, as a fraction of its size

stat/tracking-ratio.use: a stat number's tracking, as a fraction of its size

size/line.use: the one line of words in the bar (the status line, the Full Access note)

size/eyebrow.use: a mono eyebrow in the app (E1)

size/cta.use: a mono button label in the app (E2)

tracking/eyebrow.use: uppercase mono at 12: the brand's E1 tracking

tracking/cta.use: uppercase mono at 14: the brand's E2 tracking

size/typing-rank.use: the result's rank, in the serif

size/stat-xl.use: a stat's serif number, at the largest size that fits

size/stat-l.use: the next size down when the stats would not fit

size/stat-s.use: the smallest a stat is drawn

chip-hold.use: holding the chip opens the field instead of adding; longer than a firm tap

colour.use: a colour or fill changing state: the brand's transition

ease/signature.use: the house curve for everything that moves; nothing springs

typing-tick.use: how often the typing test's clock and live speed redraw

typing-flash.use: the typing field's border turning, and the countdown's thump

keep-open-first-corner.use: the first exact corner, this long after the card appears; the rest come as the screen allows

keep-open-flare.use: the cross flare when the wordmark lands in a corner

keep-open-fade.use: the Blurt-is-on card fading in over the app as the scene leaves the front, and out as it returns

space-hold.use: the space bar's hold before it moves the cursor: KeyboardKit's half second made it wait
